failure_reason: The New Arrivals hub PLP was fully verified (real Chrome page load via Claude-in-Chrome succeeded once, showing the actual product grid and its exact count). Exact product counts for the 7 genuine child listings could not be verified: the product grid loads client-side post-hydration (GraphQL/Constructor.io call requiring a browser session token, not present in server HTML); headless Playwright is hard-blocked by DataDome (403 on every URL); a second Claude-in-Chrome attempt to visit the children failed because the shared browser session repeatedly lost/reassigned its tab group between calls (foreign tabs from other concurrent workers appeared) before any further page could be loaded.
notes: The site's own main-nav mega-menu (homepage __NEXT_DATA__, props.pageProps.globalContent.headerV2.slideOutMenu.categoryMenu.menuItems) has a top-level 'New' menu whose first child is 'All New Arrivals' -> /category/new-shop-all, followed by 6 genuine sub-listings: New Furniture, New Bedding & Bath, New Rugs, New Lighting, New Wallpaper & Decor, New Pillows, plus New Nursery & Kids - an identical 7-child structure is independently confirmed by the in-page filter-chip subnav rendered on /category/new-shop-all itself (itemTitle/url pairs in that page's own __NEXT_DATA__). /category/new-shop-all was loaded in a real Chrome tab via Claude-in-Chrome: page title 'New Arrivals - Shop Our Newest Furniture & Decor | Serena & Lily', and the rendered page text shows '141 Products' directly under the filter-chip subnav, followed by ~140+ real product tiles with prices/colors/SKUs (confirmed genuine merchandising PLP, not editorial). Each of the 7 children was independently fetched via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124, HTTP 200) and its CMS-internal category name confirmed to be a real, distinct listing matching the nav label: new-furniture='New Furniture', new-bedding='New Bedding & Bath', new-arrivals-rugs='New Rugs', new-arrivals-lighting-1='New Lighting', new-decor='New Decor' (nav label 'New Wallpaper & Decor'), new-throw-pillows='New Pillows & Throws', new-nursery-and-kids='New Nursery & Kids'. All use the same category-page template as the verified new-shop-all parent, so genuine product listings are inferred with high confidence though the live grid/count could not be re-confirmed per child given access constraints. Excluded as orphaned/legacy (found only in the gzipped category sitemap, NOT linked from the current main nav or the new-shop-all subnav - superseded by the current 7-child structure): /category/new-holiday, /category/new-outdoor, /category/new-wallpaper, /category/new-swatches, /category/new-tabletop-decor, /category/new-home-shop, /category/hidden-catalog-2 (name says hidden). Checked via: full main-nav menu dump, in-page subnav on the parent PLP, full gzipped category sitemap keyword sweep (new-arrival|new-in|just-in|whats-new), and direct fetch+CMS-metadata inspection of every candidate URL.
